edicao: Raposa now sits up on the same sofa and holds up in one paw a single frog-green die, drawn as a solid 3D cube in three-quarter view exactly like the other dice in this panel (the top face and two side faces visible, rounded edges, thick outline, round pips), never a flat square, with cream pips (three pips on the top face), right next to her green plaid scarf, comparing the two greens with a satisfied half-smile, eyes half closed. Keep the sofa, her single bushy tail with the white tip, the snowy window, the little side table with its green dice, the rug, the colors and the drawing style identical. No text.
